name: Wio Bank
founded: 2022 (incorporated in Abu Dhabi as a PJSC on 23 Feb 2022; CBUAE commercial-bank licence announced 10 May 2022; Wio Business app launched 5 Sep 2022 and official launch 13 Sep 2022)
regulators: SCA (renamed UAE Capital Market Authority from 1 Jan 2026) — PJSC governance; licences of affiliate Wio Securities LLC
ownership_summary: Unlisted PJSC with AED 2.3bn paid-in capital, owned at 31 Dec 2025 by Alpha Dhabi Holding (33.15%), ADQ / Abu Dhabi Developmental Holding Company (31.85%), Etisalat (e&, 25%) and First Abu Dhabi Bank (10%). Alpha Dhabi reports its interest through a 51% joint venture, WIO Holding Restricted Limited. On 30 Jan 2026 Abu Dhabi's Supreme Council for Financial and Economic Affairs consolidated ADQ's assets and investments under L'IMAD Holding, naming Wio Bank among the portfolio companies; no Wio disclosure of a change in the registered 31.85% holder was found (checked 12 Oct 2026).

shareholders.holder: Alpha Dhabi Holding PJSC (ADX-listed; held via 51%-owned JV WIO Holding Restricted Limited per Alpha Dhabi's accounts)
ADQ (Abu Dhabi Developmental Holding Company PJSC, shown as 'ADQ / ADDH PJSC'); ADQ assets consolidated under L'IMAD Holding by SCFEA resolution of 30 Jan 2026

government_link: Yes — Abu Dhabi state investors: ADQ held 31.85% at 31 Dec 2025, and ADQ's assets (Wio named) were consolidated under L'IMAD Holding (chaired by the Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi) on 30 Jan 2026. Other holders are Alpha Dhabi, e& and FAB. Checked 2026-10-12.
group_structure: Single-entity bank: the FY2025 audited statements are not consolidated and show no subsidiaries. Wio Invest is run by a separate company, Wio Securities LLC (established Dec 2022, owned by ADQ Financial Services LLC, SCA licences 20200000072 for trading broker in international markets and 20200000165 for securities portfolio management). It is a sister company, not a Wio Bank subsidiary, so Wio Invest AUA is not in Wio Bank's balance sheet. Alpha Dhabi's notes show WIO Holding Restricted Limited (51% Alpha Dhabi) with 65% of Wio Bank's equity attributable to owners and 35% to non-controlling interests, which is consistent with Alpha Dhabi's 33.15% (51% x 65%) — our derivation, not a stated fact.
footprint: UAE only, digital-only (no branches). Registered office: Etihad Airways Centre, Abu Dhabi. 1 country of operation (Alpha Dhabi AR 2025). Checked 2026-10-12.
customer_segments: Retail individuals (Wio Personal, about 252K customers end-2025, incl. Salary and Family propositions) and SMEs, start-ups and freelancers (Wio Business, about 121K customers end-2025); corporate clients via lending and supply-chain finance; partners via Banking-as-a-Service and embedded finance. No published affluent, premier or private-banking tier found.
business_lines: Wio Personal (accounts, Saving Spaces, cards, personal loans, instalments, Wio Family from Nov 2025, creator accounts from Jan 2026); Wio Business (accounts, payments, payroll, business loans, SME cards, POS lending, supply-chain finance, multi-currency fixed deposits); embedded finance / BaaS (Magnati, TAMM, Network International, Xero integrations); investing through Wio Invest inside the Wio Personal app (operated by affiliate Wio Securities LLC: UAE and US stocks and ETFs, crypto via Fuze, Wio Wealth managed portfolios, iShares UCITS ETFs from Jun 2026); Loan Against Investments on ADX-listed shares with ADX (Jun 2026).

capabilities.wealth_summary: Wio Bank itself is a retail and SME digital bank with no private-banking or affluent tier. Investing is offered inside the Wio Personal app through Wio Invest, run by the sister company Wio Securities LLC (owned by ADQ Financial Services LLC; SCA/CMA broker and portfolio-management licences). Wio Invest offers 2,500+ UAE and US stocks and ETFs from USD 1, recurring orders, cashback AutoInvest, crypto through Fuze (VARA-regulated), and Wio Wealth managed portfolios (goal-based, AI-driven and thematic; launched by Jul 2025). It reported passing USD 1bn AUA and USD 4bn year-to-date order volume in Jul 2025. In Jun 2026 it added iShares UCITS ETFs and, with ADX, a digital Loan Against Investments on ADX-listed shares. Arta Finance announced Wio Invest as the first partner of its wealth-as-a-service offering in Oct 2024; public sources do not say which provider runs Wio Wealth.

private_banking.detail: No private-banking, premier or affluent proposition found on wio.io, in the FY2025 Directors' report, CGR 2025 or Alpha Dhabi's description of Wio.

asset_management.detail: No Wio fund manager or own-branded funds found. Portfolio management is done by affiliate Wio Securities LLC under SCA licence 20200000165 (see discretionary).

brokerage.detail: Wio Invest, operated by affiliate Wio Securities LLC (SCA licence 20200000072, trading broker in international markets): 2,500+ US (NYSE, NASDAQ) and UAE (ADX, DFM) stocks and ETFs, fractional investing from USD 1, market/limit/stop orders, instant settlement of sells. BHM Capital is the trading member for UAE markets. Fees: US 0.20% per order (min USD 0.50, max USD 4.95); ADX 15 bps; DFM 27.5 bps + AED 10; crypto 0.5% charged by Fuze.

digital_investing.detail: Wio Invest is integrated into the Wio Personal app ('Invest' tab); in operation since about 2023 ('under two years of operations' at Jul 2025). Offers stocks and ETFs, recurring orders (weekly to quarterly), cashback AutoInvest, analyst ratings, crypto, Wio Wealth portfolios and, from Jun 2026, iShares UCITS ETFs (min USD 10).

advisory.detail: No human or personalised advice service found; the app shows third-party analyst ratings only.

discretionary.detail: Wio Wealth managed portfolios ('portfolios built by experts', 'no manager needed'), run by Wio Securities LLC under its securities portfolio management licence; launched by Jul 2025 with zero fees until 31 Dec 2025. Manager/provider of the portfolios not named publicly.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: Wio Wealth offers goal-based portfolios for life milestones, AI-driven portfolios that 'adapt in real time' and thematic portfolios, all in the Wio Personal app.

funds_platform.detail: No mutual-fund shelf found. Fund exposure is through exchange-traded funds: US ETFs, Lunate Chimera ETFs on UAE exchanges (17 ETFs with recurring orders, Jan 2025) and Ireland-domiciled iShares UCITS ETFs (US, Europe, EM equities and bonds) from Jun 2026.

structured_products.detail: No structured products on wioinvest.io, in the support/pricing page or in 2025–2026 releases.

private_markets.detail: No private-markets product found on Wio pages. Arta's Oct 2024 announcement describes Arta's own suite (private investments, public-market strategies, structured products) but does not say these are offered to Wio clients.

islamic_wealth.detail: Conventional bank; no Shariah-compliant investment products or Islamic portfolios found on wioinvest.io or in releases.

opportunities: Wio Invest shelf is UAE/US stocks and ETFs, crypto, ETF-based UCITS funds and in-house-branded Wio Wealth portfolios; no structured products, private-markets or Shariah-compliant products found (S13, S14, S15).
iShares launch was framed as 'starting with BlackRock', signalling more asset-manager partners (S15).
Wio Wealth managed portfolios (goal-based, AI-driven, thematic) launched by Jul 2025; the provider is not publicly named (S8, S13).

Large, fast-growing deposit base: AED 57.3bn customer deposits at 31 Dec 2025, about 252K personal customers; Jun 2026 Loan Against Investments shows a push to link banking and investing (S3, S6, S16).
barriers: Investing sits in a separate ADQ-owned company (Wio Securities LLC), so contracting and licensing run through that entity, not Wio Bank (S8, S15).
No affluent or private-banking tier: the bank serves mass retail and SMEs (S1, S6).
CET1 ratio fell from 27.26% (Dec 2025) to 15.58% (Jun 2026) as risk-weighted assets grew (S4).
Shareholder structure is changing: ADQ's assets were consolidated under L'IMAD in Jan 2026; two directors listed in the FY2025 report no longer appear on the board page (S1, S5, S18).

discrepancies.resolution: Treated as the same regulator after renaming.

discrepancies.detail: Internal lead said L'imad 'absorbed ADQ's 31.85% Wio stake' around Jan 2026. The official release says the SCFEA consolidated ADQ's assets and investments under L'IMAD on 30 Jan 2026 and names Wio Bank; it does not describe a transfer of the Wio shareholding, and Wio's latest register (31 Dec 2025) still shows ADQ / ADDH.
discrepancies.resolution: Recorded ADQ as holder at 31 Dec 2025 with the L'IMAD consolidation noted; the lead's wording is not supported as stated.
